allow: Bash(sqlite3 "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT 'Pick', COUNT\(*\) FROM Pick UNION ALL SELECT 'PlayerProp', COUNT\(*\) FROM PlayerProp UNION ALL SELECT 'TeamPick', COUNT\(*\) FROM TeamPick UNION ALL SELECT 'Parlay', COUNT\(*\) FROM Parlay UNION ALL SELECT 'TeamParlay', COUNT\(*\) FROM TeamParlay UNION ALL SELECT 'BankrollEntry', COUNT\(*\) FROM BankrollEntry;")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT status, isDemo, COUNT\(*\) n FROM Pick GROUP BY status, isDemo ORDER BY status;")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT MIN\(date\), MAX\(date\), COUNT\(DISTINCT date\) FROM Pick;")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT scoringProfile, status, COUNT\(*\) n FROM Pick GROUP BY scoringProfile, status;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT p.date, pp.sport, COUNT\(*\) n, SUM\(p.status='hit'\) hits, SUM\(p.status='miss'\) miss, SUM\(p.status='pending'\) pend FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId GROUP BY p.date, pp.sport ORDER BY p.date;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT pp.propType, pp.sport, COUNT\(*\) n, SUM\(p.status='hit'\) hits, SUM\(p.status='miss'\) miss, SUM\(p.status='pending'\) pend FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId GROUP BY pp.propType, pp.sport ORDER BY n DESC;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT pp.direction, COUNT\(*\) n, SUM\(p.status='hit'\) hits, SUM\(p.status='miss'\) miss FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId WHERE p.status IN \('hit','miss'\) GROUP BY pp.direction;")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT placedReal, status, COUNT\(*\) FROM Pick GROUP BY placedReal, status;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT pp.propType, pp.direction, pp.line, pp.underdogLine, p.actualResult ar, pp.actualResult ppar, p.status, pp.source FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId WHERE pp.sport='MLB' ORDER BY pp.propType LIMIT 40;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT pp.sport, pp.direction, pp.propType, COUNT\(*\) n, MIN\(pp.line\), MAX\(pp.line\), SUM\(p.status='hit'\) hits FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId WHERE pp.sport='MLB' GROUP BY pp.sport,pp.direction,pp.propType;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT pp.propType, pp.direction, pp.line, pp.underdogLine, p.actualResult, p.status, p.scoringProfile FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId WHERE pp.sport='NFL' ORDER BY p.date LIMIT 45;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -line "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT p.confidenceScore, p.edgeScore, p.entryProb, p.closingProb, p.status, pp.propType, pp.direction, pp.line, p.actualResult, substr\(p.scoreBreakdownJson,1,400\) sb FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId WHERE p.scoringProfile='distribution';")
Bash(sqlite3 prisma/dev.db "select key, json, updatedAt from ProviderCache where key like 'odds%';")
Bash(sqlite3 prisma/dev.db "select nflMarketsJson, nflMaxGames, oddsCreditFloor, scoringProfile, demoMode, enableWebResearch from AppSettings;")
Bash(sqlite3 prisma/dev.db "select sport, date, count\(*\) from PlayerProp where isDemo=0 group by 1,2 order by 2 desc limit 12;")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT league, status, COUNT\(*\) n FROM TeamPick GROUP BY league, status;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT date, recommendedSide, recommendedTeam, winProbability, marketWinProb, valueEdge, priceAmerican, confidenceScore, status, actualWinner, placedReal FROM TeamPick WHERE league='NFL' ORDER BY date;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT pp.sport, MIN\(p.confidenceScore\), MAX\(p.confidenceScore\), ROUND\(AVG\(p.confidenceScore\),1\) FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId GROUP BY pp.sport;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT id,date,name,stake,payoutMultiplier,status,placedReal,\(SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM ParlayLeg WHERE parlayId=Parlay.id\) legs FROM Parlay;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT entryType,status,COUNT\(*\) n,SUM\(stake\) stake,SUM\(profitLoss\) pl, SUM\(placedReal\) real FROM BankrollEntry GROUP BY entryType,status;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT status, COUNT\(*\) n, ROUND\(AVG\(priceAmerican\),1\) avgprice, ROUND\(AVG\(winProbability\),3\) mp, ROUND\(AVG\(marketWinProb\),3\) mkt, ROUND\(AVG\(valueEdge\),3\) edge FROM TeamPick WHERE league='MLB' GROUP BY status;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT recommendedSide, status, COUNT\(*\), ROUND\(AVG\(priceAmerican\),1\) FROM TeamPick WHERE league='MLB' GROUP BY recommendedSide,status;")

Bash(sqlite3 -csv -header "file:prisma/dev.db?mode=ro" "SELECT p.id, p.date, pp.sport, pp.propType, pp.direction, pp.line, pp.underdogLine, p.actualResult, p.status, p.confidenceScore, p.edgeScore, p.scoringProfile, p.placedReal, p.entryProb, p.riskLevel FROM Pick p JOIN PlayerProp pp ON pp.id=p.playerPropId;")
